summary: 1Password and SAP have both confirmed break-ins that started with employee GitHub access. Allstate's outage is still going and the company has not said why. No official source links these or reports a coordinated attack. Stocks and Bitcoin look normal.

events.title: Allstate website, app and roadside help outage continues into day 5
events.impact: Some customers and agents still cannot pay, renew, file claims online or get roadside help online. Allstate says no one loses coverage or pays late fees. No restore time given. Downdetector showed about 150 reports Friday morning.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Allstate has not said what caused it. No confirmed evidence links it to a cyberattack, a data breach or job cuts.

events.title: 1Password confirms attacker used an employee GitHub account to reach backend systems
events.impact: Customer names, emails and account details from some customers were copied, plus private source code. 1Password says vaults and passwords were not reached and its services were not affected.
events.stated_cause: An attacker got into an employee's GitHub account and pushed bad code to backend services. How they got in and who they are is unknown.

events.title: SAP confirms a security incident in its GitHub development systems
events.impact: SAP restricted GitHub access, paused automated processes and replaced signing keys. It says it has found no sign that customer business data was reached. Media say code was copied or changed; SAP has not confirmed that.
events.stated_cause: Der Spiegel's sources say stolen employee tokens were used. SAP has not confirmed this. Who did it is unknown.

events.title: Wyoming uranium plant still shut after cyber incident
events.impact: Peninsula Energy shut its Lance plant after plant and wellfield control systems were hit. No restart date. No newer update found this run.
events.stated_cause: The company calls it a cybersecurity incident. It has not said who did it or how.

events.title: UK benefits department takes online services offline after cyber incident
events.impact: One report says online accounts and applications for Universal Credit, disability benefits and state pensions were down for claimants. Outside the US. Only one report seen.
events.stated_cause: Described as a cyber incident and a precaution. Who did it and how is unknown.

events.title: Bell MTS in Canada says an email outage was a cyberattack
events.impact: CTV reports a small group of email users had data stolen. Outside the US. No newer update found this run.
events.stated_cause: The company says it was a cyberattack. Who did it is unknown.

events.title: South African investing app EasyEquities locked out customers after cyberattack
events.impact: Customers were locked out. No restore time given. No newer update found this run. Outside the US.
events.stated_cause: The company told customers of a cyberattack with no details. Some people suspect its new app design.

events.title: Tanker attacks near Hormuz and Houthi strikes on Saudi sites keep oil near month high
events.impact: Brent crude is about 96 dollars a barrel, near its highest this month and up for the week. Ship traffic through Hormuz is far below normal. One tracker puts Brent's last close near 95.
events.stated_cause: Iran says tankers hit mines; that is not independently confirmed. The Houthis claimed strikes on Saudi energy sites. Reuters also reports continued attacks on ships.

events.title: Bitcoin about 59.8K to 61.7K USD; no crash found
events.impact: Coinbase 61,463. CoinMarketCap 61,563. OKX 61,732. CoinGecko 59,770. Prices agree within about 3 percent. Daily moves are about -1.8 to +1.5 percent. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Reports cite market worries and fund flows.

events.title: US stocks close higher in short Black Friday session after Wednesday tech selloff
events.impact: One report says the Dow rose 1.1 percent, the S&P 500 1.6 percent and the Nasdaq 2.3 percent. All 11 sectors rose. No halts or exchange glitches found.
events.stated_cause: Tech stocks bounced back after a sharp selloff. No technical cause reported.

events.title: CISA adds 3 actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers OSGeo GeoServer (two flaws) and Drupal Core. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and links the flaws to no incident above.

events.title: FAA shows no ground stops or system outages
events.impact: The FAA feed lists only routine airport closures to some private and military aircraft. No delays or ground stops. Earlier Thanksgiving-week stops were weather and a runway overrun in Miami.
events.stated_cause: None needed. No official source reports a cyber attack on air traffic systems.

connection_assessment.reasoning: 1Password says an attacker used a stolen employee GitHub login. SAP reportedly had stolen employee GitHub tokens used too, but nobody has said who is behind either. Allstate and the others have no stated cause or link. No official source ties any of these together.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement naming the same attacker or company behind several incidents, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: No confirmed evidence of a shared cause or a widespread failure. Stocks, Bitcoin and air travel look normal.

prep_note: If you use Allstate, call your agent or the phone line and keep proof of any payment. 1Password users should watch for odd emails and only use the official site or app. Developers can review and replace GitHub tokens. Keep a second way to pay bills.
